"BALLOON BLAST PRO – COMPLETE ANDROID GAME

Act as a professional mobile game development studio. Build a complete, polished, highly addictive balloon shooting game called BALLOON BLAST PRO.

The game must be designed for real Android users and eventual Google Play Store release.

1. GAME ENGINE AND PERFORMANCE

- Use lightweight HTML5 Canvas 2D with polished 2.5D visual effects.
- Use efficient JavaScript game logic.
- Use WebGL only when beneficial, with Canvas fallback.
- Optimize for low-end Android devices with 2GB RAM.
- Target smooth 60 FPS on capable phones and stable 30 FPS on low-end phones.
- Minimize CPU, GPU, memory and battery usage.
- Avoid heavy 3D engines and unnecessarily large assets.
- Support different Android screen sizes.

2. BEAUTIFUL GAME GRAPHICS

Create a premium colorful arcade environment:

- Beautiful blue sky and animated clouds.
- Colorful balloons with realistic gradients, highlights and shadows.
- Smooth balloon floating physics.
- Beautiful shooting animations.
- Visible bullets traveling towards the target.
- Attractive balloon explosion and particle animations.
- Golden balloons and special glowing balloons.
- Smooth transitions and professional visual effects.

3. SHOOTING MECHANICS

- Tap anywhere on the screen to shoot.
- Show a visible projectile travelling towards the tapped target.
- Add a small shooting animation.
- Balloons pop when hit.
- Add satisfying popping effects.
- Support multiple balloon sizes and speeds.
- Add combo shooting and bonus scores.
- Include special bonus balloons.
- Make controls responsive and accurate.

4. GAME MODES

Implement:

1. Classic Mode – Pop as many balloons as possible.
2. Time Attack – Score maximum points before time runs out.
3. Endless Mode – Survive increasingly difficult waves.
4. Challenge Mode – Complete specific balloon shooting missions.

5. LEVEL SYSTEM

- Create at least 30 progressively challenging levels.
- Increase balloon speed gradually.
- Introduce new balloon types.
- Add different backgrounds as players progress.
- Include level completion rewards.
- Save unlocked levels locally.

6. GAME UI

Create a premium animated interface with:

- Professional game logo.
- Play button.
- Level selection.
- Game mode selection.
- Settings.
- Sound controls.
- Pause and resume.
- Restart.
- Score and high score.
- Game over screen.
- Level completed screen.

7. AUDIO AND FEEDBACK

- High-quality lightweight sound effects.
- Shooting sound.
- Balloon popping sound.
- Bonus reward sound.
- Background music.
- Vibration feedback where supported.
- Separate music and sound controls.

8. LOW-END PHONE OPTIMIZATION

This is extremely important.

- Must work on 2GB RAM Android phones.
- Avoid unnecessary background processes.
- Limit simultaneous particle effects.
- Reuse objects through object pooling.
- Dynamically reduce visual effects on slower devices.
- Include Low, Medium and High graphics settings.
- Prevent overheating and excessive battery consumption.
- Support offline gameplay after installation.

9. SAVE SYSTEM

- Save high scores.
- Save player progress.
- Save unlocked levels.
- Save settings.
- Use local storage.
- Ensure saved progress survives app restarts.

10. ANDROID APP DEVELOPMENT

Prepare the game for Android packaging using Capacitor or an appropriate native Android wrapper.

Requirements:

- Unique application package ID.
- Professional application icon.
- Splash screen.
- Full-screen mobile gameplay.
- Proper Android back-button handling.
- 64-bit compatible release.
- Current Google Play target API requirements.
- Android App Bundle (AAB) generation for Google Play.
- APK generation for local testing.
- Release signing instructions.
- No unnecessary permissions.

11. GOOGLE PLAY STORE PREPARATION

Prepare:

- App name: Balloon Blast Pro.
- Short description.
- Full description.
- App icon.
- Feature graphic.
- Screenshots.
- Privacy policy requirements.
- Data safety information based on actual app behavior.
- Release-ready Android build.

Do not use copyrighted graphics, music or assets without permission.

12. FINAL QUALITY REQUIREMENTS

- Build a genuinely playable complete game.
- Do not create just a mockup or landing page.
- No placeholder buttons.
- No broken gameplay.
- Test shooting, scoring, levels, saving and restarting.
- Test performance on small mobile screens.
- Fix errors before publishing.

First complete the playable game, then prepare Android packaging.

The final result must feel like a professional arcade game available on Google Play Store.
"
